posts.line: the lamp stayed on
posts.caption:
It was supposed to be a minute. The water is still sitting there too.

#backpain

posts.line: the second cup came to me
posts.caption:
Got up for the first one. The second one did not require standing.

#backpain

posts.line: wrote nothing down
posts.caption:
The pen has been on that notebook since yesterday. Opening it felt like more than it was.

#backpain

posts.line: something easy tonight
posts.caption:
No plan for dinner. Whatever was already out is enough.

#backpain

posts.line: still alive, somehow
posts.caption:
It asks for almost nothing and still gets watered late.

#backpain

posts.line: door shut, day outside
posts.caption:
Books stacked, blanket pulled up, the rest of the day can wait in the hall.

#backpain

posts.line: this light, not the overhead
posts.caption:
The big light stays off. This one is enough for the evening.

#backpain

posts.line: nobody tells you socks become a plan
posts.caption:
Sitting on the edge of the bed for this one is allowed.

#backpain

posts.line: deciding if the pen is worth bending for
posts.caption:
It can live on the floor until someone with a better back walks by.

#backpain

posts.line: the heating pad knows you better than most
posts.caption:
Is it still a nap if the heating pad does most of the work?

#backpain

posts.line: anything below the knees is a negotiation
posts.caption:
Whatever is on the bottom shelf can stay there until the afternoon.

#backpain

posts.line: she asked if i was okay getting up
posts.caption:
I said yes and used both armrests anyway.

#backpain

posts.line: getting down to the mat is the workout
posts.caption:
Getting down there and back up again should count for something.

#backpain

posts.line: sitting down to tie shoes, at your age
posts.caption:
The bottom step has turned out to be the best seat in the house for shoes.

#backpain

posts.line: leaning on the counter so it looks casual
posts.caption:
Leaning on the counter while the kettle boils looks relaxed, and that's the whole idea.

#backpain

posts.line: two trips so nobody sees you wince
posts.caption:
An extra trip from the car is easier than explaining the face you make lifting one heavy bag.

#backpain

posts.line: standing up from the chair in stages
posts.caption:
It starts with both hands on the desk, and the rest of you catches up eventually.

#backpain

posts.line: anyone else brace before leaving the car?
posts.caption:
There's always one quiet second with a hand on the door before the twist to get out.

#backpain

posts.line: half a basket so tomorrow isn't ruined
posts.caption:
A half-full basket now beats a whole evening on the heating pad later.

#backpain

posts.line: you walk slower now and hate that it shows
posts.caption:
People pass you on the sidewalk, and you keep going anyway.

#backpain

posts.line: you sleep in one position now, on purpose
posts.caption:
The long pillow has a permanent spot on the bed, and you've stopped pretending it's decorative.

#backpain
